title: Can Prompt Modifiers Control Bias? A Comparative Analysis of Text-to-Image Generative Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly identifies 'religion/culture' as one of its primary bias categories for evaluation. It benchmarks how models represent religious figures such as 'Monks' and 'Pastors' and cultural-religious events like 'Lunar New Year' to analyze inherent demographic biases and the effectiveness of prompt modifiers in controlling them.
